name: linknest
description: LinkNest - 本地优先的网址导航知识库

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm --workspace @linknest/server run build && npm --workspace @linknest/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace @linknest/server run typecheck && npm --workspace @linknest/web run typecheck
